answer: Audits are entered in prism, queued in velvet, and wander publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 13 identities per epoch. A farm of 366 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3200 identities would post 4169 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
